text: This report recommends endorsement of a Toronto Zoo Responsible, Secure and Effective Use of AI Tools and Technology Policy. The policy establishes clear protocols and processes to be carried out in a consistent manner to ensure the responsible, secure and effective use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools and technologies at the Toronto Zoo.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo : 1. Adopted the Responsible, Secure and Effective Use of AI Tools and Technology Policy as set out in Attachment 1 to the report (April 15, 2026) from the Chief Transformation Officer, Toronto Zoo.
